messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the 3/22 postmortem — we need clear owners and short timelines for the canary/feature-flag improvements. Major buckets: auto-rollback triggers, blast-radius caps (default gate), and recurring-incident detection/telemetry. I'll drop a proposed action list below — please claim items and call out any constraints.

samir: I can own the auto-rollback config + unit/integration tests. Will prototype PR in a branch and have a draft by Tue EOD.

olga: I will take the blast-radius caps/flag gating defaults. My initial proposal: default max rollout 5% for new flags, with an override path for platform-approved launches.

kevin: Re: rollback triggers — can we make them metric-driven? e.g. `error_rate > 1.5x baseline for 3m` AND `p90 latency > 2s` on two consecutive 1m windows. Also want a soft-fail path that flips to degraded mode before full rollback.

anya: I'll update the runbook and add a step-by-step rollback checklist + who-to-@notify. ETA Wed morning.

tess: I can add dashboards for recurring-pattern detection (sampling histograms + cohorted error rates) and wire alerts to the incidents team. Need a small list of signal queries — @kevin please share the metric names you want tracked.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: `canary-safety-config v3` -> staging (sha: a1b2c3d).

oncall-bot: Incident #INC-2025-314 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2025-314

maria: Thanks. To make this actionable, here's a compact action table (claim/status/due). Add comments inline or reply with 'CLAIM' to assign.

```
- ACTION: Auto-rollback rules & e2e tests
  OWNER: samir
  DUE: 2025-04-01
  STATUS: draft PR

- ACTION: Default blast-radius caps & override policy
  OWNER: olga
  DUE: 2025-03-28
  STATUS: proposal

- ACTION: Metric-based rollback signals (query set)
  OWNER: kevin
  DUE: 2025-03-26
  STATUS: needs review

- ACTION: Runbook + rollback checklist update
  OWNER: anya
  DUE: 2025-03-26
  STATUS: in progress

- ACTION: Telemetry dashboards + recurring-pattern alerts
  OWNER: tess
  DUE: 2025-04-03
  STATUS: queued
```

maria: A couple of policy questions that need quick agreement: 1) default 5% cap (olga proposed) — thumbs? 2) require canary sampling >= 1% of traffic for metric stability before rollout increases.

olga: +1 on 5% default. We should also require a mandatory 15-min observation window for any +increase >5%.

kevin: Agree on the 1% minimum sampling. I'll post the exact metric queries in a follow-up comment by EOD.

samir: One implementation note — auto-rollback should prefer targeted rollback (flag=false for affected cohorts) vs global rollback when possible. I'll add that to the PR.

maria: Good. Last thing: recurring-incident detection. We saw similar degradation patterns across two incidents last quarter. Action: set a recurring incident rule to surface common error clusters to the SRE triage board. Who can own the initial triage rule?

tess: I'll take initial ownership for the triage rule and sample queries. Will sync with kevin for metric names.

maria: Perfect. Let's reconvene Thu 11:00 for a 30m sync to review progress and unblock any cross-team needs. If you can't make it, leave a note here.

kevin: I'll be on PTO Thu morning but can join the recap if it's after 11:30. Otherwise I'll post the queries.

olga: ACK, will update the proposal doc with override flow and owner details.

samir: CLAIM (auto-rollback + tests).

anya: CLAIM (runbook).

maria: Thanks all — this thread will be the single source of truth for who does what. I'll convert the code-block actions into tickets after the sync and ping owners with ETA reminders. :thumbsup:
